changes.result: B10/B11/B12 source ready in shared cwd, uncommitted per owner integration instruction. OpenCode v2 existing-session queue/steer exact options/inputId; v2 fresh Start compatibility retained; v22 native fresh Start only unchanged. ZCode queue/sync/steer exact options; Codex legacy native receipts unchanged. Exceptions sanitized with method/expected/correctiveAction and mutation UNKNOWN/nonretryable. 4MiB request/response frame enforced incl newline, oversized export fails visibly without truncation; stream continues. Final 49/49 targeted tests across 6 files, tsc --noEmit exit0, diff --check exit0. Codex real legacy Unix WebSocket fixture proves one native steer for repeated stable inputId. Source/fixture proof only, no runtime/deploy/credentials/CI adapters touched. Owned 9 paths: src/ahap-{opencode,zcode,browser,codex}-runner.ts, src/ahap-legacy-read.ts, tests/ahap-{opencode,zcode,codex,legacy-read}-runner.test.ts. Env AHAP_CODEX_SOCKET xor AHAP_CODEX_BIN, AHAP_CODEX_CWD absolute, HOME from owner code_home, optional CODEX_HOME absolute. Remaining gap: full public installed consumer acceptance belongs to integration/CI; optional legacy projects only when available; exports >4MiB explicit unsupported. CI-reported OpenCode v2.2.4 family-v2 proof is separate external evidence.
